purpose: Canonical source-to-document routing for agents and change checks. Code, schemas, registries, and checked runtime data remain authoritative for behavior.
coreRules: Prefer the smallest root-cause fix; avoid unrelated refactors.
Update matching docs for behavior, API, pipeline, methodology, or data-source changes.
Do not replace DefiLlama list supply with manual/on-chain/CMC/DEX overrides; supplemental supply admission paths must be explicit, documented, fail-closed, and double-count safe.
Keep Tailwind classes as static strings.
Do not edit shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/ unless explicitly required.

mappings.label: Daily data graphics for manual social publication
rules: Use the Europe/Belgrade calendar for edition identity and the 14:00 target, including DST.
Require fresh data and a verified image before an operator posts an edition by hand; the Worker never tweets these graphics automatically.
Keep the dated manifest immutable.

mappings.label: Stablecoin data and research sidecars
rules: Keep canonical order, generated data, and schemas aligned.
Commit base coin sources before final sitemap-date generation.
Do not add ad hoc supply overrides outside documented fail-closed admission paths.
Failure scenarios: only the maintainer approves exact content, and any edit invalidates its content hash; drafts never publish in production.
Failure-scenario verification is pinned and read-only; changed and unavailable rows require maintainer review, and unregistered falsifiers stay explicitly unchecked.
hints: Update methodology docs only when scoring or classification semantics change.

mappings.label: Pricing and supply pipelines
rules: Consume or cancel failed fetch bodies before opening more Worker fetches.
Do not multiply DefiLlama list-endpoint supply by price.

mappings.label: Live reserve evidence and consumers
rules: Reserve provenance describes evidence actually read, not merely the configured feed; preserve snapshot admission and retained-attempt distinctions.
Published serial/basket edges own the map; review leads never create edges without current claim identity and measured weight or reviewed serial/mechanism semantics.

mappings.label: Domain yield producers and consumers

runbook.label: Yield benchmark fallback or stale state
Yield history cleanup and writer pause

rules: Keep source observation, publication, and read-time freshness distinct; missing yield evidence is not a measured zero.

mappings.label: Homepage contract
rules: Preserve the homepage cohort, availability, and server-to-live handoff contracts.

mappings.label: About page contract
rules: Keep public data-source descriptions aligned with the implemented sources.

mappings.label: Coverage page contract
rules: Unavailable data is neither covered nor uncovered and must not enter coverage denominators.

mappings.label: Start page contract
rules: Preserve shared onboarding-retirement state and the internal route registry boundary.

mappings.label: Feedback pipeline contract
rules: Preserve idempotency and unknown execution outcomes; do not retry ambiguous GitHub submissions as new issues.

mappings.label: Compliance evidence and workbench
rules: Compliance is sourced editorial evidence, not pipeline inference; official authorization claims require issuer-specific regulator evidence.

mappings.label: Admin API bindings and handlers
rules: Admin endpoints retain Access authentication, no-store responses, and mutation idempotency; locate the endpoint-specific contract in the admin reference.

mappings.label: Worker API and authentication
rules: Route flags, auth lane behavior, cache metadata, and site-data allowlists are centralized.

mappings.label: Worker cron and scheduled pipelines

runbook.label: D1 capacity pressure and runtime experiments

rules: Pick the trigger slot before adding fetch-heavy work.
Cron jobs use Pharos's conservative six-connection trigger budget; consume response bodies before opening more fetches.
Remote D1 inspection uses SELECT via --command, never --file (the import API locks writes).

mappings.label: Telegram ingress, commands, dispatch, and Mini App
rules: Preserve webhook authentication, signed initData validation, and idempotent update handling.
Preserve the durable delivery evidence trail.

mappings.label: D1 schema or migration
rules: Migrations must be backward-compatible because CI applies D1 migrations before the new Worker is live.
Destructive cleanup requires a separate coordinated rollout.

mappings.label: Methodology and scoring
rules: Methodology versions increase numerically: after v5.9 use v5.91 or v6.0, not v5.10.
hints: Structured methodology changelogs live under shared/data/methodology-changelogs/; update the matching entry for semantic changes.

mappings.label: Safety Score V9 and publication surfaces
rules: Current consumers fail closed when the accepted V9 publication is unavailable or held.
Safety Score V9 Economic Control owns the sole published mint score.

mappings.label: Worker environment contract
rules: Environment documentation names variables only; never print or copy secret values.

mappings.label: Status model and operational runbooks
rules: Status causes, recommended actions, public-health floors, and runbooks must remain aligned.

mappings.label: Deployment, CI, and repository policy
rules: Keep deploy-surface classification aligned with GitHub deploy behavior.
Commit relevant sources before generating git-history-derived artifacts.

mappings.label: Script implementation and local tooling
hints: Read generated-artifact or operational guidance only when the script touches those contracts.
Use check:focused -- --file <path> to select affected generated artifacts; script tests retain source-reading and CLI contracts.

mappings.label: Agent guidance and local hook process
rules: Top-level AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are deliberately kept in sync; an already-loaded AGENTS.md supplies the root rules, and CLAUDE.md is the edit target only for root guidance changes.
Temporary agent output belongs in ignored scratch locations, not committed docs.

mappings.label: Depeg & Recovery route composition
rules: The hero block is the sole owner of the route's headline figures; no module below it restates the active count, worst live move, at-peg split, or tracked DEWS alert count.
Label every figure's universe: tracked peg-status set, DEWS-covered assets, and open resolver rows are three different denominators.
Keep the event archive server-rendered; it is the crawlable link hub for permanent event pages.

mappings.label: Interactive table export contracts
rules: Export as-of timestamps identify source-data generation, not download time.
Unknown values and provenance remain unknown in published export cells.

mappings.label: Frontend page or route behavior
rules: Static export means route metadata, sitemap, and crawlability can matter even for simple UI changes.
hints: Use check:focused -- --file <path> for related tests on frontend modules; non-module changes retain directory coverage.

mappings.label: Worker runtime implementation
rules: Consume Worker response bodies before opening more fetches.

mappings.label: Shared runtime contracts
rules: Use @shared/lib/... and @shared/types... for shared runtime imports; avoid relative cross-boundary imports.

mappings.label: Verified documentation
rules: Treat docs/ and README.md as the verified documentation corpus.

exclusions.reason: Directory sentinel only; read the stablecoin registry contract for real entries.
Implementation-only tests and fixtures; read the matched parent contract.
Implementation-only generated or licensed assets; read the matched design or font contract.
